Parameters:
  • out_dir (string) – Path where the HLL files will be created.
  • req_class_names ([string]) – List of names of GSS classes containing requirements.
  • reporter (Reporter) – Object used to log notes, warnings and errors.
  • generic_header (string) – Header to print at the top of SafetyProperties.hll.
